Introduction

VVS is a South Korean girl group under MZMC Inc. They made their debut on April 22, 2025 with the digital single "Tea".

The group name means '5 VS' but also refers to the 'VVS' category from the modern GIA diamond grading system. It symbolizes the individuality and teamwork of the five members, as well as their overwhelming perfection.

Through the release of their EP "D.I.M.M." on May 19, 2025, it was revealed that VVS has added a new member, Lena, to their lineup.
